notes.title: Portugal Tourism GP launch!
notes.content:
Take advantage of the launch discount and support this project!

Play until you unlock all levels, stereotypes, and game modes, then compete with other players in Arcade Online mode to see who’s the best!
Can you reach the top of the online leaderboards?

O Portugal Tourism GP! is an isometric pixel art game that takes players on a journey through Portugal’s most iconic locations. Players take on the role of European stereotypes, racing through vibrant pixel art environments inspired by real tourist destinations.

In each level, players must tackle unique challenges and objectives, such as tasting local cuisine, visiting famous attractions, and managing their budget. The goal is to experience everything each destination has to offer while spending as little as possible.
